name: Jean-Marc Germain, Monika Hohlmeier - Après le § 17 - Am 12
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: 17a. Recalls that ECA special report 03/2024 concluded that the Commission did not systematically assess and document the impact on the EU’s financial interests for all Member States in which it identified challenges to the rule of law;
